root_idea.summary: The root centers on making something heavy by placing one thing upon another.
root_idea.development: Its clearest image is a living child weighed down and hidden by earth; related vocabulary describes the heavy sound of movement, while other derived usages record concealment and measured, calm conduct.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized singular feminine passive-participle citation form.

senses.definition: A female child buried alive under earth.
senses.usage_conditions: Feminine passive participle of وَأَدَ, used substantively for the victim of the burial.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Coitus interruptus: withdrawal during intercourse to prevent conception.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression, literally “hidden burial”; also called الصُّغْرَى in the cited lexical tradition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the earth or land, to hide or conceal someone, as if removing him from sight.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the construction تَوَأَّدَتْ عَلَيْهِ الأَرْضُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To act or proceed with moderation, gentleness, deliberation, or calmness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of conduct, affairs, or gait, including the constructions اِتَّأَدَ فِي أَمْرِهِ and اِتَّأَدَ فِي مَشْيِهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A loud or heavy sound, such as that of a falling wall, heavy footsteps, or a camel’s braying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The meaning includes the heavy sound produced by vehement treading, especially the feet of camels.
The feminine وَئِيدَةٌ and the abbreviated form مَوْدَةٌ are also recorded with this meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man who buries his daughter or daughters alive.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Agent noun for the perpetrator of this act.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Moderation, gentleness, deliberateness, or a leisurely manner of proceeding; gravity, sedateness, and calmness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Describes conduct, deportment, or walking in contrast to haste; variant spellings include تُؤْدَةٌ and تُودَةٌ.
Explicitly reported as a transposed form of مَآوِدُ.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The heavy-treading specialization is covered by the broader sound meaning.
The camel-braying specialization is covered by the broader sound meaning.
Pointer-only cross-reference to the already represented hidden-burial expression.
Pointer-only cross-reference to وَئِيدٌ and وَأَدَ.

cautions: The calamities meaning under مَوَائِدُ is explicitly described as a transposition from another lexical form; it is retained as a reported Classical attribution rather than treated as a core derivation of the root.
